# CANDIDATE: AFTERNOON_VWAP_MEAN_REVERSION_WITH_RSI

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In the afternoon, when price deviates more than one ATR from VWAP and RSI is extreme, a mean‑reversion snap back to VWAP occurs. This captures intraday exhaustion moves that are not covered by the morning‑biased VWAP_CONTINUATION setup.

## Mechanism

Using a 5‑min chart, compute 14‑period ATR. After 12:00 ET, if price > VWAP + 1*ATR and RSI(14) > 70, enter short at the bar's close; if price < VWAP - 1*ATR and RSI < 30, enter long. Require the ribbon to be neutral (8‑EMA within 0.1% of 21‑EMA) to avoid strong trends. Exit: chart‑stop at VWAP (structure invalidation), TP1 at 0.5R, runner using a premium‑stop of 15% of entry premium (or chandelier trail). Regime hint: optimal when VIX is between 12‑22 and price remains within ±0.5% of the open (no strong trend); avoid FOMC or high‑impact news days.
